answer: Anchor each identity at a wharf: a head may only load cargo if it moors at a pier whose berth is rented by a distinct established operator, and berths are capped so one operator cannot host an unbounded fleet. Every launched claim sends a ripple across the water that neighbouring berths must detect, and any berth that ignores a ripple it clearly saw loses its licence. Standing is then dried into cedar planks, each plank stamped with the berth that shipped it, so a clone can only present wood from a berth that really handled the load.
